protocol: protocol Section 66; registry Section 11 (SG5); refinements of Section 59

attributions.W: class word, frozen convention: mean over class pieces of p, softmax over the 77 padded keys (reference)
attributions.WK: p_T / (p_T + p_SoT) (the class word in OVAM's two-key form)
attributions.WN: log p_T - log mean_{j not in T} p_j (target against the mean non-target position)
attributions.WE: log p_T - log mean_{j in EoT and padding} p_j (target against <EoT> and padding)
attributions.WY: mean of p_T over the class word and its fixed synonyms, each in the same prompt template (synonym ensemble)
attributions.TC: OVAM released token, keys [<SoT>, token], conditional query (few-shot reference)
attributions.TS: log p_tok - log p_SoT for the same token and keys

pipelines.REF: one pass through SA module 15, mean_i(A_i c)
pipelines.R2: OVAM DenseCRF on the REF mask
pipelines.P1+R2: OVAM DenseCRF on the P1 mask (FTF for the class word)

adoption: A seed replaces the class word (or the token) in a frozen pipeline only if the pipeline screen (FTF or T-C) freezes it under protocol v1.2. A REF-screen result alone is reported as a seed finding.
diagnostics: seed recall, precision and FP per object pixel at 0.45 (AN1 metrics) for every attribution and pipeline, on VOC-Sim and COCO-Cap
transfer: COCO-Cap: every cell at the threshold chosen for it on all of VOC-Sim; each screen's frozen cell against its reference (paired bootstrap); reported, never selected
